pagesRead.content:
Estimate the latest GPT-5.6 and Claude Opus 5 token costs

Use this AI token calculator to instantly estimate the cost of tokens across major AI models. Find out how much it will cost you to use the latest GPTs, Claude, Gemini or DeepSeek LLMs for text input and output.

What You Can Do With This AI Token Calculator

This AI token calculator helps you measure and compare token costs, token usage, and API costs across different models such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Google Gemini. Use it to understand the maximum input and maximum output allowed by each model so you can manage token usage and costs more efficiently.

Estimate API token costs for input tokens, output tokens, and cached tokens. Use this AI token calculator to identify which model fits your budget and performance needs.

Each token calculator result includes characters, word count, input token, and output token estimates. You can view total token costs per model, monitor API costs, and plan your text processing within the token limit. No Excel sheet needed.

Compare GPT Models (and others)

Compare models like GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity Sonar, DeepSeek, and Grok with real-time token calculator data.

Current API Prices for the Latest LLM Models

These are the latest models’ API costs per input and output tokens.

All prices are per 1 million tokens

OpenAI’s newest flagship model. Frontier reasoning for complex professional work, with a 1.05M-token context window and reasoning effort configurable up to max.

Google’s most capable Flash model for agentic workflows and multimodal reasoning. Promotional pricing runs through 31 December 2026 — rates double to $1.50 input / $7.50 output on 1 January 2027.

Anthropic’s flagship model for complex agentic coding and enterprise work. Claude Fable 5 — the next-generation model for long-running agents — sits above it at $10.00 input / $50.00 output.

Grok 4.6 is xAI’s flagship model for code, agentic tool calling, and long-context work. The standard Grok 4.6 rate applies below 200K context, with a 500K-token context window available for larger requests.

DeepSeek-V4-Flash is the efficiency champion on this calculator. It is built for fast reasoning and code generation, with thinking and non-thinking modes, a 1M-token context window, and separate peak and off-peak pricing.

A high-precision search and reasoning engine designed for deep-dive research tasks and verifiable agentic citation workflows.

Programming language token efficiency, ranked

These rankings come from the RosettaCode task comparison discussed earlier, using GPT-family tokenization as the baseline. The pattern is simple: terse functional and dynamic languages stay compact, while verbose low-level and enterprise languages burn more tokens for the same job.

The AI Token Cost Calculator is a free tool that helps you estimate how much it costs to process text using different AI language models. It breaks down input, output, and total costs for providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Perplexity, DeepSeek, and Grok.

Tokens are chunks of text that AI models use to process language. One token is roughly four characters of English text. For example, the word “ChatGPT” is about two tokens.

Because every AI model charges per token, knowing the token count helps you predict costs before sending text to the API. It’s especially useful if you run chatbots, automation tools, or content generators and want to manage expenses accurately.

Yes. The calculator automatically generates pricing cards for all major AI models so you can easily compare costs across providers in one place.

Yes. As new AI models and pricing are released, the tool will be updated to include them so you always have the most accurate cost comparison.

The most expensive model on this calculator is OpenAI’s o1-pro, at $150 per 1M input tokens and $600 per 1M output tokens. Among current-generation flagships, gpt-5.5-pro and gpt-5.4-pro sit at $30 input / $180 output per 1M tokens, and gpt-5.6-cyber at $12.50 input / $75 output.

The cheapest text model to date is OpenAI’s gpt-5-nano, priced at $0.05 per 1 million input tokens and $0.40 per 1 million output tokens.

Output is usually more expensive because the model has to generate new tokens, not just read the prompt. On current flagship models, output often costs 3x to 6x more than input, which is why the expected output size setting can change the final estimate so much.

pagesRead.content: Synonyms token American [toh-kuhn] / ˈtoʊ kən / noun tokens plural something serving to represent or indicate some fact, event, feeling, etc.; sign. Black is a token of mourning. a characteristic indication or mark of something; evidence or proof. Malnutrition is a token of poverty. a memento; souvenir; keepsake. The seashell was a token of their trip. something used to indicate authenticity, authority, etc.; emblem; badge. Judicial robes are a token of office. Also called token coin. a stamped piece of metal, issued as a limited medium of exchange, as for bus fares, at a nominal value much greater than its commodity value. anything of only nominal value used in exchange for goods or services, as paper currency. virtual token. an item, idea, etc., representing a group; a part as representing the whole; sample; indication. The religious movement was an exhibition of latent energy, and a token of what may take place at some future day. a person, especially a member of a minority group, who has been hired, admitted, enrolled, etc., to forestall charges of prejudice or discrimination. an object, as a disk or figure, used in various board games for marking a player's position or for keeping score. Logic, Linguistics. a particular instance of a word, symbol, expression, sentence, or the like. A printed page might have twenty tokens of the single type-word “and.” verb (used with object) to be a token of; signify; symbolize. adjective serving as a token. At the end of the field trip each child received a token gift to take home as a memento. The HR complaint was filed by a man who felt his hiring had been meant to add a token male to an all-female staff. Synonyms: symbolic slight; nominal; minimal. token resistance; a token amount. idioms by the same token, moreover; furthermore. She has a talent as a painter, and by the same token has a sharp eye for detail. in proof of which. The study examined the possible effects of stress on health and, by the same token, IQ and test scores. in token of, as a sign of; in evidence of. a ring in token of his love. token British / ˈtəʊkən / noun an indication, warning, or sign of something a symbol or visible representation of something something that indicates authority, proof, or authenticity a metal or plastic disc, such as a substitute for currency for use in slot machines a memento a gift voucher that can be used as payment for goods of a specified value (modifier) as a matter of form only; nominal a token increase in salary linguistics a symbol regarded as an individual concrete mark, not as a class of identical symbols Compare type philosophy an individual instance: if the same sentence has different truth-values on different occasions of utterance the truth-value may be said to attach to the sentence-token Compare type moreover and for the same or a similar reason "Collins English Dictionary — Complete & Unabridged" 2012 Digital Edition © William Collins Sons & Co. Ltd. 1979, 1986 © HarperCollins Publishers 1998, 2000, 2003, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2009, 2012 verb (tr) to act or serve as a warning or symbol of; betoken "Collins English Dictionary — Complete & Unabridged" 2012 Digital Edition © William Collins Sons & Co. Ltd. 1979, 1986 © HarperCollins Publishers 1998, 2000, 2003, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2009, 2012 token More Idioms see by the same token; in token of. Other Word Forms Derived Forms pretoken noun Inflected Forms Nouns tokens plural Etymology Origin of token First recorded before 900; Middle English token(e), tokin(e), Old English tāc(e)n, tācon; cognate with German Zeichen, Old Norse teikn, tākn “sign, mark”; see teach Explanation When you give someone a flower or a friendship bracelet or something symbolic of the way you feel about them, you're giving them a token of your affection. A token is not only something sentimental (like a keepsake) or symbolic (like your friendship bracelet). You, yourself, can also be a token: If you're the only female in your office, for instance, and you were hired just so there'd be at least one woman, then you're the "token female." Tokens can also be a kind of special currency, like the coins you use in slot machines. Before the Metro Card, New York City subway riders paid their fares with tokens. sourcesEvaluated.lyDoTinCay: Công cụ tính toán trực tuyến, cung cấp định nghĩa cơ bản và bảng giá tham khảo. Tuy nhiên, không có tác giả rõ ràng và dữ liệu giá có thể thay đổi theo thời gian thực mà không có dấu mốc thời gian cụ thể trong nội dung scrape.
canhBao: Số liệu giá API có thể thay đổi thường xuyên, cần kiểm tra lại tại thời điểm sử dụng.
sourcesEvaluated.doanTrich: Tokens are chunks of text that AI models use to process language. One token is roughly four characters of English text.

sourcesEvaluated.lyDoTinCay: Nội dung scrape chủ yếu là các nhãn giao diện (UI labels) và trạng thái 'Loading...', thiếu nội dung văn bản giải thích hoặc dữ liệu tĩnh để trích dẫn bằng chứng cụ thể về định nghĩa hay lý thuyết.
sourcesEvaluated.lyDoLoai: Thiếu nội dung văn bản hữu ích do lỗi scrape hoặc trang động quá mức, không thể trích xuất đoạn trích nguyên văn có ý nghĩa giáo dục.
sourcesEvaluated.doanTrich: Note: Different models use different tokenizers, so direct token-based price comparisons may not be entirely accurate.

sourcesEvaluated.lyDoTinCay: Từ điển uy tín, cung cấp định nghĩa ngôn ngữ học chính xác về 'token' (một instance cụ thể của từ/ký hiệu), là nền tảng để hiểu khái niệm token trong NLP.
canhBao: Định nghĩa mang tính ngôn ngữ học tổng quát, cần kết hợp với nguồn kỹ thuật để áp dụng vào AI.
sourcesEvaluated.doanTrich: Logic, Linguistics. a particular instance of a word, symbol, expression, sentence, or the like.

sourcesEvaluated.tieuDe: LLM API Pricing Calculator: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini | GPT for Work
sourcesEvaluated.lyDoTinCay: Công cụ tính giá API từ bên thứ ba. Cung cấp định nghĩa kỹ thuật về token trong ngữ cảnh OpenAI và bảng giá chi tiết. Độ tin cậy trung bình vì là nguồn thương mại, không phải tài liệu học thuật chính thức.
canhBao: Giá API được liệt kê có thể không phản ánh chính xác giá hiện tại nếu không được cập nhật liên tục.
sourcesEvaluated.doanTrich: A token is a part of a text that can be word, subword, punctuation mark or symbol. It is the unit of account of OpenAI APIs.

thongTin.noiDung: Token trong ngôn ngữ học là một instance cụ thể của một từ, ký hiệu, hoặc biểu thức.

bangChung.doanTrich: Logic, Linguistics. a particular instance of a word, symbol, expression, sentence, or the like.

thongTin.noiDung: Trong các mô hình AI (đặc biệt là OpenAI), token là một phần của văn bản, có thể là từ, từ con (subword), dấu câu hoặc ký hiệu, và là đơn vị tính toán chi phí API.

bangChung.doanTrich: A token is a part of a text that can be word, subword, punctuation mark or symbol. It is the unit of account of OpenAI APIs.
bangChung.viTri: Mục FAQ: What is an OpenAI token?

bangChung.doanTrich: Tokens are chunks of text that AI models use to process language. One token is roughly four characters of English text.

thongTin.noiDung: Chi phí sử dụng AI thường được tính dựa trên số lượng token đầu vào (input) và đầu ra (output), với đơn vị tính phổ biến là trên mỗi 1 triệu token.

bangChung.doanTrich: All prices are per 1 million tokens

thongTin.noiDung: Chi phí cho token đầu ra (output) thường cao hơn đáng kể so với token đầu vào (input), thường gấp 3 đến 6 lần trên các mô hình flagship.

bangChung.doanTrich: Output is usually more expensive because the model has to generate new tokens, not just read the prompt. On current flagship models, output often costs 3x to 6x more than input
bangChung.viTri: Mục giải thích về chi phí

thongTin.moTaMauThuan: Chỉ có một nguồn xác nhận tỷ lệ này. Các nguồn khác (n04) liệt kê giá cụ thể nhưng không tổng kết tỷ lệ chung, tuy nhiên dữ liệu giá ở n04 (ví dụ: gpt-5.6-sol: $5 input / $30 output) cũng hỗ trợ xu hướng output đắt hơn, nhưng không nêu rõ tỷ lệ 3x-6x một cách tổng quát.
